tools.name: describe
tools.description: Version and capabilities of this CAD comparison server. Call it once if you need to know which file types are supported.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare two STEP part files (single parts, not assemblies) and say whether they are the same part. Use it when the user asks whether two CAD files differ, what changed between two versions of a part, or whether a part was only moved or mirrored. The files are read locally and never uploaded. Returns verdict (same / moved / different) and, when different, the changed features with sizes, e.g. {type: "through_hole", change: "modified", attr: "diameter", from: 6, to: 6.5, location: [150, 90, 10]}. Typical time: under a second for simple parts, 5–15 s for parts with several hundred faces. Multi-body parts (several solids in one file) need CAD Compare Pro; the free version returns license_required for them. Report warnings to the user; they say when the result needs care.

a.description: Absolute path to the first part file (A, usually the older version) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

b.description: Absolute path to the second part file (B) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

tools.name: fingerprint
tools.description: Geometric fingerprint of one STEP part, independent of position and orientation (volume, area, principal sizes, face types). Use it to recognise the same part under different file names or to sort many files before comparing pairs; two parts with clearly different fingerprints are different, similar fingerprints still need compare.

path.description: Absolute path to a part file (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

tools.name: compare_assembly
tools.description: Compare two versions of a STEP assembly: which parts were added, removed, renamed or replaced, which parts changed shape (with the changed features, as in compare), quantity changes, and which parts or subassemblies moved or changed parent. Use it when the files are assemblies (compare reports them as unsupported) or the user asks what changed in a product structure. Also works when one side is a single part. Files are read locally and never uploaded. Typical time: a few seconds for tens of parts, up to a minute for hundreds. If warnings contains not_all_parts_compared, say so and offer to rerun with a higher max_detailed_parts. Requires CAD Compare Pro (see describe → license).

a.description: Absolute path to the first assembly file (A, usually the older version) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

b.description: Absolute path to the second assembly file (B) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

max_detailed_parts.description: How many changed-looking parts to compare geometrically (default 40; each takes about 0.1–5 s)

tools.name: find_duplicates
tools.description: Find STEP part files in a folder that are the same part: identical copies, re-exports, or the same part moved or rotated, whatever the file names. Also reports left/right (mirror-image) pairs. Use it to clean up a messy project folder, find which supplier file matches which drawing, or avoid making the same part twice. Files are read locally and never uploaded. Only files whose fingerprints match are compared in full, so large folders are feasible; typical time is 0.1–1 s per file plus 0.3–5 s per comparison. Assemblies are skipped (listed in skipped). Requires CAD Compare Pro (see describe → license).

folder.description: Absolute path to a folder on this computer

max_files.description: Check at most this many files (default 200), in name order

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Write a comparison report of two STEP files (parts or assemblies) as a self-contained HTML file that can be printed to PDF: verdict, the list of differences in plain language, key figures, and for assemblies the changed, added, removed and moved parts. By default it also contains an interactive 3D view (rotate, zoom, measure; click a difference in the list to show it), which works offline in any browser. Use it when the user wants something to keep, send to a colleague or supplier, or attach to a change request, or wants to see the change in 3D. It writes one file on this computer and never overwrites one unless overwrite is true. Returns the path and a file:// url; give the user the url as a link to open it. Requires CAD Compare Pro (see describe → license).

a.description: Absolute path to the first file (A, usually the older version), a part or an assembly (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

b.description: Absolute path to the second file (B) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

output.description: Absolute path for the report, ending in .html (default: next to B, named <A>_vs_<B>.html)

language.description: Report language: en, de or zh (Chinese); default en. Use the user's language

view_3d.description: Include the interactive 3D view (default true; makes the file a few MB). Set false for a small, print-only report

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at output (default false; ask the user first)

tools.name: render_diff
tools.description: Picture of where two STEP parts differ, as PNG images you can look at: an overview and, when there are differences, a close-up. Coloured as in the CAD Compare viewer: faces identical in both grey, differing faces of A red, of B green, and numbered markers whose meaning is in legend (the same differences compare lists). For parts that were only moved or mirrored, B is shown with A's outline on top. Use it when the user wants to see the change, or to check a result visually. Rendered locally without a GPU; files are never uploaded. Requires CAD Compare Pro (see describe → license).

a.description: Absolute path to the first part file (A, usually the older version) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

b.description: Absolute path to the second part file (B) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

view.description: Viewing direction (default iso: from front-right, above)

output_dir.description: Also save the PNGs into this existing folder (absolute path)
